dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: *yawn* Sorry, I'm a bit tired. I think it's because of the stones... Have you ever heard anyone talk about how they have a mysterious energy?

dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: I don't know what the Fontaine Research Institute engineers do with the stones. But they form here, looking like that. Just thinking about them makes me sleepy...

dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: If... If you can avoid it, don't go over there. Otherwise I'll need to write a report... *yawn*
